name: MATERIAL
note: user works in MDF; birch plywood also suitable

name: MATERIAL_THICKNESS
note: NOMINAL - measure the real sheet before cutting

name: CLEARANCE
note: total across each slot - UNTESTED FIT

name: SLOT_WIDTH
note: MATERIAL_THICKNESS + CLEARANCE

name: MORTISE_LENGTH
note: TAB_LENGTH + CLEARANCE

name: SLOT_DEPTH
note: through-mortises; rail halvings to mid-height

name: CNC_BIT_DIAMETER
note: sizes every dogbone relief

name: RELIEF_RADIUS
note: CNC_BIT_DIAMETER / 2 + 0.2

name: KERF_COMPENSATION
note: apply the tool-radius offset in CAM; the DXF is net part geometry

name: SHEET_SIZE
note: standard sheet; confirm the supplier size

name: SHEET_EDGE
note: clamping margin

name: WIDTH
note: outer arm face to outer arm face

name: DEPTH
note: frame; + back foam

name: HEIGHT
note: arch crowns; + 40~50 mm back cushion

name: SEAT_FRAME_HEIGHT
note: deck top; + 120~140 mm seat cushion = ~450

name: ARM_HEIGHT
note: top of the drum (spacer caps)

name: SEAT_BAYS
note: one arch per bay, 426.5 mm clear each

name: POST_HEIGHT
note: rib / arm post tops behind the arches

name: PLINTH_RECESS
note: between 120 mm feet front and back

name: GRAIN_DIRECTION
note: not applicable to MDF; for plywood, run rail grain along the length
